title.narrative: Documentation of the Tangible and Intangible Cultural Heritage of the Uma Lulik (Timorese Traditional Sacred House)

description.narrative: The Uma Lulik of Timor-Leste are traditional sacred houses that embody the social and historical memory of the Timorese people, serving as powerful symbols of cultural identity and continuity. The project aims to document and preserve the tangible and intangible cultural patrimony of Uma Lulik, supporting Timor-Leste's efforts to gain UNESCO recognition and enhance cultural heritage awareness. Activities include comprehensive research and documentation across multiple municipalities, producing films, photo books, and exhibitions, and engaging local communities through educational and promotional efforts.
